newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's top trade partners Germany, Italy, Russia.
newsitem.headline: Poland's top trade partners Germany, Italy, Russia.

text.p: Poland's top trade partners last year were Germany, Italy and Russia, which collectively received 47 percent of the country's exports and delivered 41 percent of imports, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said on Friday.
Germany remained Poland's top market, buying 34.4 percent of the country's exports and supplying 24.7 percent of imports.
Earlier today GUS said Poland's registered trade doubled to $12.7 billion in 1996 with exports rising 6.7 percent to $24.44 billion and imports 27.8 percent to $37.14 billion.

NOTE - Figures compiled from GUS reports for countries which are in the top 10 in both exports and imports. Percent is the share a given country has of total exports or imports. Figures in brackets are for percent share in 1995.
